Q8137.reason: Act of State is the rule that domestic courts will not judge the validity of a foreign State's public territorial acts, effectively shielding those acts from judicial scrutiny.

Q5849.reason: Computer business records need more than a 'kept in the ordinary course' statement; FRE 803(6)/901 require extra foundation on system reliability and authentication.

Q5779.reason: Unused peripheral cannulas are commonly flushed with 0.9% saline every 8 hours (and before/after each use) to keep them patent.
